title: Diane Powell's inbox full of parents saying their children read their thoughts

tellings.quote: email box was filled of parents reaching out saying saying I'm finding that my child can read my thoughts

plain: A filmmaker named Ky Dickens, who made a documentary called The Telepathy Tapes, told podcast host Jesse Michels about a researcher named Diane Powell. She says that around 2022 and 2023 Powell's email inbox filled up with messages from parents saying they had found their children could read their thoughts. If true, it would point to mind reading being far more common than people think.
